title: Phase 03C - Directive doctor, gate, and import-export enforcement
description: Validate directive coverage and integrity through doctor, closeout gates, and import/export.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor reports missing required directives, unknown IDs, deprecated emissions, duplicate IDs, invalid data, unsafe text, stale registry versions, and conflicts.
Import/export and closeout gates preserve and validate directive bundles or acknowledgements.
closedReason: All Phase 03C child tasks are closed, validation passed, and no new source commit was needed for the parent rollup.
